children: LCI Industries' third-quarter net sales declined 4.2% year over year, while net income also fell. Lower North American RV wholesale shipments drove sales down, partly offset by commodity-indexed pricing increases, automotive aftermarket growth and acquired-business sales. Cost improvements supported operating margin, but earnings were lower.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Segment net sales fell 7%, mainly on lower travel trailer and fifth-wheel shipments; adjacent industries sales rose 7%.
: Segment net sales increased 6%, primarily on higher automotive aftermarket volume; operating profit declined $1.0M.
: Operating margin rose to 6.0% from 5.5%, helped by commodity-indexed pricing and sourcing-related cost improvements.
: The proposed Patrick Industries merger, announced June 30, is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals and other conditions.
